name: TC-EV-01: Check Truck Price lead submits successfully on Electric Commercial Vehicles
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/ElectricVehicle.cy.js#CategoryPages - ElectricVehicle [en] — Electric Commercial Vehicles TC-EV-01: Check Truck Price lead submits successfully on Electric Commercial Vehicles
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-EV-01
**Title:** Check Truck Price lead submits successfully on Electric Commercial Vehicles
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Electric Commercial Vehicles page, click a truck card's "Check Truck Price" button to open its lead form (the same shared Check Offers modal used elsewhere on the site), fill name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
A Thank You confirmation is shown after a successful lead submission.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Electric Commercial Vehicles page
2. Click a truck card's "Check Truck Price" button to open its lead form
3. Fill name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify Thank You confirmation
